memory: The realization that a connection doesn't just exist in the background—it becomes a part of your daily frequency. It is the rare kind of closeness where someone genuinely understands the rhythm of your thoughts without needing constant explanation.
hardHittingLine:
I only pray you never leave me behind

Because your music can be so hard to find

I take your head and pull it closer to mine

Our love is never dying, a chain in my mind

My heart's a stereo

It beats for your, so listen close

Hear my thoughts in every note
whyThisLine: Because a true friendship isn't static; it is an active, pulsing rhythm that you carry with you. It captures the simple beauty of someone becoming an integrated part of your emotional life.
